version_control.title: Version Control
version_control.git_status_tooltip: Git manages version history for all vaults under the storage root: track changes, push to remote repositories (GitHub/Gitee), and collaborate across devices. Use it to rollback mistaken restores from file sync or full backup. Desktop only.
version_control.git_scope_desc: The Git repository lives at the storage root and tracks changes across all vaults (journals, sessions, attachments, etc.). Each vault's `.baishou/` directory is excluded and managed by File Sync instead.
version_control.remote_config_help:
The Git remote backs up content files under your storage root across all vaults (journals, attachments, etc.). It is separate from per-vault .baishou/ incremental sync.

Configure in this page:
1. Create an empty private repo on GitHub / Gitee
2. Remote URL: HTTPS clone URL, e.g. https://github.com/user/repo.git
3. Branch: match the remote default (often main or master)
4. For HTTPS: platform username + Personal Access Token (not your login password)
5. Click Save in this section, then Test connection

Or configure in a terminal at the storage root:
git remote add origin <repo-url>
git branch -M main
git push -u origin main
After that, you can enter the same URL here to push/pull from the app.
version_control.discard_confirm_message_file: Unstaged changes to "{{path}}" will be permanently discarded.
version_control.discard_confirm_message_untracked: Untracked file "{{path}}" will be permanently deleted.
version_control.discard_confirm_message_all: All unstaged changes to tracked files will be discarded, and untracked new files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
version_control.rollback_confirm_message: HEAD will move to commit "{{message}}" ({{hash}}). All changes after that commit will remain as unstaged working tree changes for you to review, stage, or commit.
version_control.rollback_warn_dirty: You already have uncommitted changes. After rollback they will appear together with the changes from rolled-back commits.
version_control.rollback_warn_remote: A remote is configured: {{count}} local commit(s) will be removed from the current branch. If they were pushed, you may need a force push later. Proceed with caution.
version_control.rollback_file_confirm_title: Undo this commit's change to the file?
version_control.rollback_file_confirm_message: Changes from commit {{hash}} to "{{path}}" will be undone in the working tree (not auto-committed).
version_control.commit_placeholder: Enter commit message (timestamp used if empty)
version_control.author_not_configured: Please set your Git commit username and email in Git Commit Signature before committing
version_control.scope_lead: Tracks writing and source files across workspaces. Desktop only.
version_control.mobile_hint: This page manages vault Git settings, not a workbench folder repo. The phone can initialize an empty repo, save the remote, and probe connectivity. Commit and push need the desktop Git command line.
version_control.mobile_cli_unavailable: This mobile build has no Git command line, so commit and remote sync cannot run. You can still save configuration and initialize the repo; finish the push on desktop.
version_control.remote_probe_http_only: Only http/https remote probing is supported
version_control.no_commit_files: This commit has no file changes to show
version_control.no_newline_eof: No newline at end of file

round_rollback.confirm_desc: Files will be restored to their state before this round, and this round and all following messages will be removed. This cannot be undone.
round_rollback.scope_note: Only paths touched by AI write tools in this session are covered; this cannot replace version control.
round_rollback.help_scope: Session rollback only covers known AI write-tool paths; use version control for important checkpoints.
round_rollback.preview_files_label: Files the assistant changed (these will be withdrawn):
round_rollback.preview_extra_label: These files also changed, but not by the assistant directly (command output or your own edits):
round_rollback.preview_cascade: The {{count}} rounds after this one will be undone as well.
round_rollback.preview_no_files: No files changed in this round; only the conversation will be removed.
round_rollback.scope_attributed: Withdraw only files the assistant changed
round_rollback.scope_attributed_desc: Your own edits and command output stay as they are.
round_rollback.scope_all: Withdraw every file change from this period
round_rollback.scope_all_desc: Includes the extra files listed above that the assistant did not change directly.

workspace_edit_resend.confirm_desc: This round and later messages will be withdrawn first, then your edited text will be sent again. Choose below how to handle files. This cannot be undone.
workspace_edit_resend.failed: Edit and resend failed. Files may have been rolled back—review and try again.
